meta.title: FinTax workbench
meta.description: DSH sidebar workbench for offline statements and .zip archives from 8 sales platforms plus 3 settlement wallets (WorldFirst, Payoneer, Airwallex) with 3-stage fund-chain cross-checking, 11 tax calculators (including rebate cancellation/battery excise impact & dual-track annual bonus IIT), rolling 12-month trend reports, CSV exports, and Tencent IMA policy search.
